Title: Patrologiae Cursus Completus, Series Graeca, tomus XCI (Maximus the Confessor, vol.
    II)
Creator: Maximus the Confessor (c. 580-662) (J.-P. Migne, compiler; Greek with Latin)
Publisher: Paris, Migne, 1860
Rights: Public Domain
Rights basis: 1860 publication, out of US copyright by date; the item carries no copyright field of
    its own, so the imprint date is the basis, read directly 2026-10-23.
Language: grc (Greek with Latin; the Latin is what the OCR reads)
Source: Internet Archive item bim_early-english-books-1641-1700_1860_91
    (archive.org/details/bim_early-english-books-1641-1700_1860_91), fetched directly
    (curl, raw bytes) from the item's own _djvu.txt full-text file, 2026-10-23, Library
    thread (Era III).
Provenance note: Raw, uncorrected djvu OCR (rough, second witness only). Runs of 2+ spaces collapsed to
    one; no wording changed. Sections: Migne columns; the Disputation at raw lines ~216
    and ~15044. Credit line for a reader-facing page: "Patrologia Graeca 91 (Migne,
    1860)". Whole text republishable.
Content note: Maximus's disputation at Carthage with the ex-patriarch Pyrrhus in 645, in the African
    church's city. No public-domain English exists.
